info.name: ParaSwap Market API v5 prices API

params.name: srcToken
params.description: Source Token Address or Token Symbol (for tokens from /tokens).

params.name: srcDecimals
params.description: Source Token Decimals; can be omitted if Symbol is provided for `srcToken`.

params.name: destToken
params.description: Destination Token Address or Token Symbol (for tokens from /tokens).

params.name: destDecimals
params.description: Destination Token Decimals; can be omitted if Symbol is provided for `destToken`.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount in the Denomination of Source Token

params.name: otherExchangePrices
params.description: _If provided_, **others** object is filled in the response with price quotes from other exchanges (if available for comparison).

params.name: includeDEXS
params.description: Comma Separated List of DEXs to include without spaces.

params.name: excludeDEXS
params.description: Comma Separated List of DEXs to exclude without spaces.

params.name: includeContractMethods
params.description: Comma Separated List of Contract Methods to include without spaces.

params.name: excludeContractMethods
params.description: Comma Separated List of Contract Methods to exclude without spaces.

params.name: route
params.description: Dash (-) separated list of tokens (addresses or symbols from /tokens) to comprise the price route. Max 4 tokens

items.docs: Returns optimal swap route and pricing across all integrated DEXes for a given token pair and amount.
